benchmark_note: Questions were generated from the sample PDFs (see benchmark metadata), not written by domain experts.

evaluation.accuracy: 0/1/2 from required-fact coverage (>=80% -> 2, >=40% -> 1); abstentions score 0; normalised as score/2
evaluation.context_fact_recall: share of required facts present in the supplied context
evaluation.context_fact_bearing_precision: share of supplied chunks containing at least one required fact
evaluation.gold_page_retrieved: a supplied chunk includes the validated gold page
evaluation.claims: answer sentences labelled supported when >=60% of content terms and all numbers occur in the context; 'unsupported' means not established by the context, not false; contradictions are not detected
evaluation.citation_validity: share of [S#] markers that refer to a supplied source
evaluation.limitations: Heuristics have not been validated against human judgements. No LLM judge is used.
